what: Parameters of tools/v11_post.py (eleventh version = tenth version + K4 + K2-ego + E1, a post-processing step on the tenth version's per-segment files). Chosen on opened development data only (Chunk_6, Chunk_7 first and second half); Chunk_8 was only a reference, because the three changes were thought of after its answers were opened.

development_batches.C6: comma2k19 Chunk_6, data/output/dash_scale/blind_v7 (seventh version, sealed; ninth-version file *_cars_v7.json), tenth version rebuilt by tools/v10_post.py
development_batches.C7a: comma2k19 Chunk_7 first half, /mnt/d/depth_work/v9dry/run (ninth-version dry run, not sealed; groups from blind_v8), tenth version rebuilt by tools/v10_post.py
development_batches.C7b: comma2k19 Chunk_7 second half, data/output/dash_scale/blind_v9 (ninth version, sealed), tenth version rebuilt by tools/v10_post.py
development_batches.C8_reference_only: comma2k19 Chunk_8, the joint blind batch (v9d, sealed) and data/output/dash_scale/blind_v10; its answers were opened 2026-10-20 19:24, before these changes were thought of, so it cannot confirm them

scoring_for_choosing: settled shared rules as re-implemented in /mnt/d/depth_work/decisions_20261018/g1/rescore_lib.py (S rules): second car truth = processed radar - 0.70 m, matching centre column 615 (589 before 2018-06-25--22-19-02), first car - 0.33 m and 598; truth <= 30 m; readings beyond 60 m or <= 0 m carry no number. Ego speed truth: mean pose speed over the second's 20 frames.

rules.K4: distance, every group: for every sample and object of the tenth-version file, on its boxes before any blanking, cov_front = max over the other objects j of the same sample with y1_j > y1_i + front_px of area(box_i intersect box_j) / max(area(box_i), min_box_area_px2) (0 when there is none); edge = x0_i <= edge_px or x1_i >= image_width_px - edge_px (the bottom edge is not used). cov_front >= cov_front_min or edge, with a distance: dist_v10 = dist, dist = null (no number; a scorer drops it after the matching, as a blank dist_m), k4 = {cov_front, edge}, v11_steps += [K4]. Every other field is unchanged.
rules.new_ego_seconds: only segments whose tenth-version file has no ego value at all, whose <tag>_run.json has status ok, and whose camera A (tools/v10_post.camera_A: median of the camera's drive medians, leaving out the segment's own drive) exists. K2-ego: night group and next_candidate.source camera k night. E1: local_day or night group, source current, <tag>_dash.json status not ok, and the ninth-version file has no ego value. The main group is never changed.
rules.per_second: per 1 s bin b in [0, floor(n_frames / fps)) of the run: speed pairs with kmh not null and b <= t_s < b + 1 (jump pairs carry no kmh and drop out; unchecked pairs stay); each pair's camera-A speed v = kmh x A_camera / A_local, A_local of the run's ruler entry with frame == frame_i (no entry: the bin is dropped); n >= min_pairs: raw = median(v), sigma_raw = hypot(median_se_factor x sd(v, ddof 1) / sqrt(n), raw x s), s = mean ci_half of the run's lines_used / 1.96 (= depth_dash_multicar.ruler_scale_sigma), hw9 = z x sigma_mult x sigma_raw.
rules.smoothing: the tenth version's step_c2 with the group's C2 values below, on the new seconds only (local_day weighted by 1 / max(hw9, min_halfwidth_kmh)^2, night unweighted; >= min_seconds_for_line seconds within +-h_s for a straight line, else the weighted mean). Uses up to h_s seconds after the second: an after-the-fact measurement, as C2.
rules.range: sigma_kmh = factor x sigma_raw, ci95_kmh = factor x hw9, factor per (group, path); factor = the 95th percentile over C6, C7a, C7b of |C2 value - mean pose speed of the second| / hw9 (numpy linear percentile, rounded to 4 decimals).
rules.not_changed: the segment's ego_refused text, distances (other than K4), relative speeds and absolute speeds; absolute speed is not filled for the new seconds. Refused segments stay refused.

choices_after_looking: E1 only in the local_day and night groups (Terry 2026-10-20 23:4x): in the main group its new seconds had a mean |error| of 3.1-3.4 km/h on C6 / C7a against 1.8-2.2 km/h for the existing seconds (C7b has no such segment).
night range factor split by path (camera-k / own-ruler): one pooled night factor 0.6049 left the E1 night seconds at 79-92 % leave-one-batch-out coverage.
the K4 thresholds (30 %, 3 px, nearer box bottom + 2 px) come from the Chunk_8 error analysis.
values_note: C2 values = tools/v10_params.json values.C2.local_day / night (h_s, weighted, min_halfwidth_kmh, min_seconds_for_line). min_pairs, median_se_factor, z, sigma_mult = the marking method's own per-second rule (tools/depth_dash_multicar.py ego_bins with the measure-c ego_sigma_mult 1.9).

honest_estimate.note: leave-one-batch-out coverage of the 95 % range of the new ego seconds (factor learned on the other two development batches), from /mnt/d/depth_work/v11dev_20261020/out/ranges/factors.txt; in-sample numbers with the fixed factors are a check only
